text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • TENDINITIS (less common): true inflammation from rheumatologic

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: disease, acute overload or infection → rest, ice, compression, elevation

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: (RICE), anti-inflammatories, treat the cause · recovers faster

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • TENDINOSIS (more common): collagen degeneration from chronic

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: overuse, NO inflammation → therapies that rebuild collagen, analgesics ·

svg.text: • 1 · Educate: what it is, what to expect, change the offending activity

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • 2 · Relative rest (by time or task) · ergonomics · ice · orthoses or taping

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • 3 · Physiotherapy: ECCENTRIC strengthening twice daily × 12 weeks ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • 4 · Anti-inflammatories (topical preferred) help less in tendinOSIS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • 5 · Platelet-rich plasma (PRP)? · surgical referral if refractory
